reviews.x: I used these on my Red Wing Iron Rangers in Copper Rough and Tough (8085). It definitely darkened them a bit which is mildly disappointing but I’m okay with it. It softened and conditioned the leather nicely but it definitely dulled the finish. Brushing seems to make it worse. I won’t use this product again.

reviews.t: Great product, poor or faulty bottle cap.
reviews.x: This is a great product which deserves a higher rating, however, I have to take the shipping and as received condition into account. The bottle cap push top is extremely easy to open and as a result came open at some point during shipping and leaked out about an ounce of product into the plastic bag it was in. The bottle cap is to blame here as it requires very practically no effort to open it. Maybe it is defective or a poor design but ultimately I lost some of the product that I paid for. I’ll

I bought this because several reviews noted that it would not darken your boots.  It did darken them some.  It did everything else fine.  I was glad it only darken them a little bit.  I wish I would have taken before and after pictures.  I put this on new Iron Rangers.

I've been treating boots with different products for a long time. I normally use other brands, but this one was the leader on all of the "top five" lists I saw and I figured I'd try it out on my new Danners - the heavy old-fashioned ones made of thick full-grain leather. I also used it on a pair of boots with thinner leather.  I don't know what else to say other than that it deeply penetrates the leather and leaves behind the kind of soft and oily-but-more-waxy-than-oily feel that you want from

reviews.t: Ruined leather wallet, terrible on leather boot
reviews.x: Tried this on my Saddleback leather wallet thinking it would condition and restore/ protect it.  It turned the wallet dull, splotchy and uneven, took a lot of pigment out especially around the spine of the wallet.  Did nothing to improve the overall condition, still had dry looking spots, no improvement to the leather in any way.  Followed directions correctly and even brushed/ buffed with horsehair brush.  Terrible result and wife is upset since it was a special gift.  Also applied on a test sp

reviews.t: Easy to use and works well.
reviews.x: Used this on a pair of boots that have seen most of nature. They have climbed mountains, walked thru soggy wet grass, seen Florida's sugar sand pits and climbed up piles of horse manure. All of this without any conditioning in their 3+ years of abuse. With just one treatment, the shoes look better. The shoe in front is untreated and the back shoe is conditioned. Had a slight darkening effect for ~24 hours but returned to the original color.

FABULOUS stuff!! I collect vintage 40s cowboy boots. This stuff soaks in, with zero residue or film. It has no scent whatsoever, and I don’t even have to wash my hands afterwards; it soaks into my skin. Nourishes the leather and, because it’s all natural, I don’t have to worry about it ruining my boots. Showed it to my cobbler, and he is going to see about doing a bulk order. It’s that good.

reviews.t: Boots are so much more comfortable now
reviews.x: The color of my dark brown boots did change a bit, but you'll get this from any conditioner (I like the new color more anyway).  The boots were brand new, aside from a couple hours of walking, and it turned the heels from unbearable and blustery to perfect. I will definitely be using this throughout this pair's lifetime and get more for every pair in the future.

reviews.t: Amazing product to help lengthen life of the leather
reviews.x: As shown (photos arent in order), I used it on a pair of cowboy style work boots. I have had these boots for 4+ years and given zero maintenance to them whatsoever. I decided to give thw leather a little love to extend the time until I must buy another pair of boots. The boots took nearly the entire smaller bottle worth of conditioner. Two months later after the leather absorbed and distributed the conditioner about it likely could use the remainder of the bottle to finish it up. The last photo

reviews.t: Like massage oil for your leather goods
reviews.x: It took 5 coats but I’ve refinished a pair of old DocMartins ballet slippers, and working on all my other leather goods w/this - will probably need a new bottle sooner than later! Good stuff, as a professional massage therapist I work w/oils and this oil is as yummy and soothe soaks into my skin just as easily as the leather I’m working on. Love it!

Caution using this product.  It not only significantly darkened my boots, but left it looking marbled.  Gonna be tossing those boots and sending this junk back.  Really mad bc I loved my boots and the latest version of the boots (I’ve heard) is no longer good.
I use this on all my leather products. Used it on my grandfathers leather tool belt, that had been used hard for 50 years. Used this product (2 coats) and now I use it proudly.
Reviews say wont darken. I get it, you are oiling leather. However it darken my boots beyond the norm.

I use several different brand conditioners, cleaners and waterproofing sprays. This conditioner can be used on almost every leather except suede, Nubuck or rough out. It is wax based and oil based so it will darken the color of your leather a couple of shades. That said I did like it a lot, there is no weird smell it is easy to apply, it penetrates real well and pretty fast. The scuff covering is fair, it does make your leather water repellent not waterproof. Based on the characteristics of this

reviews.t: this spilled all over in the box, during the shipping.
reviews.x: 32. 00 is a lot of money to pay for a leather conditioner\restorer  so my expectations of this product were a little high. So the most ive ever paid for a product like this is around 20 dollars. So when i purchased this i thought to myself maybe this stuff is " the good stuff" that actually does what its supposed to do. I desperately needed something to condition and some what restore as i restore leather designer items in my small business. I was super excited to get this! So when i recieved th

This is the best shoe conditioner that I have ever used. I used to only use mink oil to polish and condition my boots but I found this off of TBC.com. They sell this for all Thursday’s smooth leather boots. It is super simple to use and you only need a small amount to condition the heck out of your boots. Read instructions but it’s simple: 1) clean off your boots with a horsehair brush 2) put a dime sized amount on a microfiber cleaning cloth 3) apply on your boots in a circular fashion. 4) allo

As usual the Cobbler's Choice line of boot products performs amazingly. Yes Saphir is probably the best for what it does (shine and overall aesthetics) . But this stuff is very reasonably priced, works great, conditions extremely well, dries quickly, and is honestly the best stuff for your boots in a lot of other ways. It doesn't shine like the Saphir but as all the other Cobbler's Choice products do? It succeeds in it's intended purpose (conditioning) extremely well.

reviews.t: All natural, goes on easy, doesn't darken too much, no smell
reviews.x: My first time conditioning good boots (Scarpa Terra GTXs bought from Zappos). I chose Cobbler's Choice brand after a lot of research. I didn't mind some darkening. Application was easy: unlace, apply with cloth, rub around for even distribution. Absorbs quickly. No perceivable smell. Then, brushed with Cobbler's Choice horsehair brush. Easily covered scuffs. Photo taken immediately after brushing.

reviews.t: This stuff works pretty darn well.
reviews.x: Here are my 6 month old work boots, with a fresh wash and after using this conditioner. It’s been another month or so and they are holding up great. We had a rain up at a new home build and it got MUDDY. I even got my truck stuck for a minute or two. That said, I got my boots immediately dirty again, but they seem pretty well protected here. I’d buy again.

Not the best, I had a piece of leather without any treatment that I applied cobbler’s choice to vs. obenauf’s. Then I let a few drops of water sit on top of the treated areas for an hour.  The obenauf’s had better water resistance. Also I was shipped the cobbler’s choice with the can leaking because the cap was loose.

Do your re-search and you will notice petrol as a main ingredient in most leather care products.  Petrol additives are not good for leather in the long term.  This has none!  This version is less heavy duty than the cream and works great if you don't want to darken some leathers.  Highly recommend.

As a conditioner I suppose it is good enough. One thing of concern:  I applied it with bare fingers, as I usually do. I like the feel of the leather. Afterward, I experienced an irregular heartbeat. I have used gloves since and have not experienced the issue again. FYI: This is my experience; YMMV

Put some of this on my Thorogood boots, it was exactly what I was looking for! Didn’t want a glossy shine but I wanted to get something that would condition the leather really well. That’s exactly what this stuff did. It softened the leather a little bit but not so much so that it was concerning.

reviews.t: Extended life to old leather boots
reviews.x: Obviously you can't restore 12+ yr old boots to "new" leather, but the ingredients gave deep penetration to old cowboy boots that hadn't been treated in over a year of near-daily wear, including barn chores ! So if I give them a "little" more regular care, boots should last several more years !

reviews.t: Should give this more than a couple days for the darkening to settle down
reviews.x: Does what it claims to do. I liked the info before purchase that said it left a natural scent on the leather. That proved true in my case though it took several days to get that way. I used it on cowboy boots. I think it made the boots softer but less scuff resistant in the process.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the product darkens leather, sometimes more than expected or desired.
Several reviewers say the product conditions and softens leather well, improving the look and feel of boots.
Some reviewers complain that the bottle cap opens easily and the product leaks during shipping.
A few reviewers report the product left leather dull, splotchy, or marbled and ruined their items.
Some reviewers note the product has little to no scent and absorbs without residue.
